description: RSVP to a free event on this site (Wix Events). NOBODY IS ON THE GUEST LIST YET: a confirmation email goes to the address you provide, and the RSVP is only submitted when that person clicks the link (expires in 24 hours). Tell the user to check their inbox. Use a real address belonging to the person you are acting for — the confirmation link is deliberately not returned to you.

email.description: The guest's own email — the confirmation link is sent here.
